goal: The agent must OFFER the next moves rather than hand back a blank text box: every turn that has an obvious next step ends with a `suggest` block, which the window renders as clickable chips. It must do this WITHOUT reverting to asking permission — the offer follows work already done.
_comment_settings: COMFYUI_URL is injected at run time via --set; the placeholder keeps this file credential-free.
turns: what can you do with my comfyui? give me something simple to start with
_comment_checks: message_says is the point of this scenario: a capability that lives in what the agent SAYS is invisible to every tool-shaped check, and an instruction the model quietly ignores is the commonest way a shipped feature does nothing. The no_* checks guard the regression that matters — chips must not become a permission gate.
